name: Roper
summary: A stalagmite-like aberration that reels in prey with sticky tendrils.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The roper makes two Tentacle attacks, uses Reel, and makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.onHit:
The target has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=14}) from one of six tentacles, and the target has the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition until the grapple ends.

The tentacle can be damaged, freeing a creature it has {ref:condition/grappled} when destroyed (AC 20, HP 10, {ref:glossary/immunity} to Poison and Psychic damage). Damaging the tentacle deals no damage to the roper, and a destroyed tentacle regrows at the start of the roper's next turn.

actions.name: Reel
actions.text: The roper pulls each creature {ref:condition/grappled} by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.
